quran.t: And do not come near adultery. It is immoral, and an evil way.
Tell the believing men to restrain their looks, and to guard their privates. That is purer for them. God is cognizant of what they do.
And do not occupy yourself with what you have no knowledge of. The hearing, and the sight, and the brains—all these will be questioned.
Does he not know that God sees?
He knows the deceptions of the eyes, and what the hearts conceal.
But as for him who feared the Standing of his Lord, and restrained the self from desires. Then Paradise is the shelter.
Recite what is revealed to you of the Scripture, and perform the prayer. The prayer prevents indecencies and evils. And the remembrance of God is greater. And God knows what you do.
Successful are the believers. Those who are humble in their prayers. Those who avoid nonsense.
Those who safeguard their chastity.
By time. The human being is in loss. Except those who believe, and do good works, and encourage truth, and recommend patience.
The life of this world is nothing but game and distraction, but the Home of the Hereafter is better for those who are righteous. Do you not understand?
Abundance distracts you. Until you visit the graveyards.
God intends to lighten your burden, for the human being was created weak.
“Yet I do not claim to be innocent. The soul commands evil, except those on whom my Lord has mercy. Truly my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful.”
Have you seen him who chose his desire as his god? Would you be an agent for him?
As for him who was defiant. And preferred the life of this world. Then Hell is the shelter.
Those who are righteous—when an impulse from Satan strikes them, they remind themselves, and immediately see clearly.
Say, “O My servants who have transgressed against themselves: do not despair of God’s mercy, for God forgives all sins. He is indeed the Forgiver, the Clement.”
Those who believe, and whose hearts find comfort in the remembrance of God. Surely, it is in the remembrance of God that hearts find comfort.
O you who believe! Seek help through patience and prayers. God is with the steadfast.
With hardship comes ease. With hardship comes ease.
He who created death and life—to test you—as to which of you is better in conduct. He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.
And those who do not bear false witness; and when they come across indecencies, they pass by with dignity.
Among the people is he who trades in distracting tales; intending, without knowledge, to lead away from God’s way, and to make a mockery of it. These will have a humiliating punishment.
Do not extend your eyes towards what We have bestowed on some couples of them to enjoy, and do not grieve over them, and lower your wing to the believers.

And do not extend your glance towards what We have given some classes of them to enjoy—the splendor of the life of this world—that We may test them thereby. Your Lord’s provision is better, and more lasting.
And when they hear vain talk, they avoid it, and say, “We have our deeds, and you have your deeds; peace be upon you; we do not desire the ignorant.”
But you prefer the present life. Though the Hereafter is better, and more lasting.
The life of this world is nothing but diversion and play, and the Home of the Hereafter is the Life, if they only knew.
The life of this world is nothing but play and pastime. But if you have faith and lead a righteous life, He will grant you your rewards, and He will not ask you for your possessions.

And those who do not implore besides God any other god, and do not kill the soul which God has made sacred—except in the pursuit of justice—and do not commit adultery. Whoever does that will face penalties.
The punishment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will dwell therein in humiliation forever.
Those who love to see immorality spread among the believers—for them is a painful punishment, in this life and in the Hereafter. God knows, and you do not know.
But whoever seeks anything beyond that—these are the transgressors.

The adulteress and the adulterer—whip each one of them a hundred lashes, and let no pity towards them overcome you regarding God’s Law, if you believe in God and the Last Day. And let a group of believers witness their punishment.

Until, when death comes to one of them, he says, “My Lord, send me back. That I may do right in what I have neglected.” By no means! It is just a word that he utters. And behind them is a barrier, until the Day they are resurrected.

And give from what We have provided for you, before death approaches one of you, and he says, “My Lord, if only You would delay me for a short while, so that I may be charitable, and be one of the righteous.”
Then, on that Day, you will be questioned about the Bliss.
What drove you into Saqar? They will say, We were not of those who prayed. Nor did we feed the destitute. And we used to indulge with those who indulge.
Mankind’s reckoning has drawn near, but they turn away heedlessly.
Leave them to eat, and enjoy, and be lulled by hope. They will find out.
So leave them to blunder and play, until they encounter their Day which they are promised.
So that a soul may not say, “How sorry I am, for having neglected my duty to God, and for having been of the scoffers.”
And on that Day, Hell is brought forward. On that Day, man will remember, but how will remembrance avail him? He will say, “If only I had forwarded for my life.”
Did you think that We created you in vain, and that to Us you will not be returned?
Woe on that Day to the deniers. Those who play with speculation.
Whoever has done an atom's weight of good will see it. And whoever has done an atom's weight of evil will see it.

bible.t: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
But I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.
Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
“All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.
Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise; redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality, that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor.
Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.
But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed. Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin; and the sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul.
The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
But I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be rejected.
Throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God, and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ.
Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise.
The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul. He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned? Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
For she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army. Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap. For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep? A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.

Rejoice, young man, in your youth, and let your heart cheer you in the days of your youth, and walk in the ways of your heart, and in the sight of your eyes; but know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment.
But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’
Whereas you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.
Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment.
For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ; that each one may receive the things in the body, according to what he has done, whether good or bad.
He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

popular.t: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
While we are postponing, life speeds by.
How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.
Lost time is never found again.
You may delay, but time will not.
Time is what we want most, but what we use worst.
The chains of habit are too weak to be felt until they are too strong to be broken.
We must all suffer one of two things: the pain of discipline or the pain of regret.
Either you run the day or the day runs you.
No man is free who is not master of himself.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
Hard choices, easy life. Easy choices, hard life.
The cost of a thing is the amount of what I will call life which is required to be exchanged for it.
Discipline is choosing between what you want now and what you want most.
The urge will pass in a few minutes, whether you give in or not. Let it pass.
Every no makes the next no easier. Every yes makes the next no harder.
Nobody ever looked back and wished they had scrolled more.
You won't remember one video from today. You will remember what you built.
Your future self is watching what you do right now.
You decided this earlier, with a clear head. Trust that version of you.
Lust promises everything and leaves you with less than before.
Real people deserve your respect, not your screen time.
The feeling after giving in is never worth the minutes before it.
You are not bored. You are avoiding something. Go and face it.
Feeds are built to never end. You have to be the one who stops.
One hour a day is fifteen full days a year. Spend them on purpose.
Stand up, drink water, step outside. The urge is weaker than you think.
Strong people are not those who never feel the pull. They walk away anyway.
Close this. Open your goals instead.
Every hour you waste is gone for good. Nobody can give it back to you.
Lust takes more than it gives: your time, your energy, your respect and your peace.
The pleasure lasts minutes. The shame and the lost day stay much longer.
What you feed grows. Feed this urge and it will ask for more tomorrow.
Secrets kept from the people you love cost you their trust when they come out.
A wasted day becomes a wasted week, then a wasted year. It starts with this minute.
Scrolling feels free. You pay with the hours you will wish you had back.
Habits you hide are habits that own you.
The person you want to become would close this right now.
One day you will run out of time. Don't spend it on things you wish you hadn't.

hadith.t: There are two blessings that many people are deceived into losing: health and free time.
Whoever can guarantee (the chastity of) what is between his two jaw-bones and what is between his two legs, I guarantee Paradise for him.
The adultery of the eyes is the sight (to gaze at a forbidden thing), the adultery of the tongue is the talk, and the inner self wishes and desires and the private parts testify all this or deny it.
When an adulterer commits illegal sexual intercourse, then he is not a believer at the time, he is doing it.
O young people! Whoever among you can marry, should marry, because it helps him lower his gaze and guard his modesty, and whoever is not able to marry, should fast.
Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler.
The (Hell) Fire is surrounded by all kinds of desires and passions, while Paradise is surrounded by all kinds of disliked undesirable things.
Allah has a sense of Ghira, and Allah's sense of Ghira is provoked when a believer does something which Allah has prohibited.
If you don't feel ashamed, do whatever you like.
The most beloved deed to Allah is the most regular and constant even if it were little.
Verily Allah does not look to your bodies nor to your faces but He looks to your hearts.
The adultery of the eye is the lustful look, and the adultery of the tongue is the licentious speech, the heart desires and yearns.
The world is sweet and green (alluring) and verily Allah is going to install you as vicegerent in it in order to see how you act.
Indeed among the excellence of a person's Islam is that he leaves what does not concern him.

The feet of the slave of Allah shall not move on the Day of Judgement until he is asked about five things: about his life and what he did with it, about his knowledge and what he did with it, about his wealth and how he earned it and where he spent it on, about his body and for what did he wear it out.
Do not follow a look with a look, the first is for you, but the next is not for you.
Have Taqwa of Allah wherever you are, and follow an evil deed with a good one to wipe it out.
Every son of Adam sins, and the best of the sinners are the repentant.
Leave what makes you in doubt for what does not make you in doubt.
